composition.title: The Community Library
composition.content: On Saturday morning, I arrived at the community library before the doors opened. Volunteers had already stacked donated books beside the entrance, and several children waited with their parents. I helped carry the boxes inside. At first I thought the work would be simple, but the labels on the shelves were confusing and I put two boxes in the wrong place. The librarian showed me how the books were arranged. After lunch, a girl asked for a story about the ocean. I looked through three shelves before I found one about coral reefs. She sat by the window and began reading while I returned to the desk. By late afternoon the boxes were empty and the shelves were full. I was tired when I left, and I kept thinking about the girl reading by the window.

criteria.rationale: The ending describes an image but does not explain why the experience mattered.

evidence.excerpt: I was tired when I left, and I kept thinking about the girl reading by the window.

criteria.rationale: The events are ordered, but the transition around the middle is abrupt.

evidence.excerpt: After lunch, a girl asked for a story about the ocean.

criteria.rationale: The words are clear and appropriate.
